stem.text: The structure of lactic acid is shown.

stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of lactic acid: CH3 and a CH carbon bearing a vertical OH group, joined to a carboxylic acid carbon with a C=O drawn above it and an OH to the right.
stem.label: lactic acid

stem.text: Which esters might form when lactic acid is heated?

items.alt: Six-membered cyclic diester (lactide, 3,6-dimethyl-1,4-dioxane-2,5-dione): two ring O atoms, two C=O groups, and two ring CH carbons each bearing a CH3 group.
